title: FindMySpot live state message
description: One state message, broadcast over the WebSocket whenever occupancy changes. This is the interface between the vision lane and the web lane. Additive changes only: fields may be added, never renamed or removed.

camera_id.description: Which camera zone this state describes.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the frame this state was derived from.

spots.description: Keyed by spot id. Every monitored spot appears every message.

status.description: held means a driver has claimed it and it is not offered to anyone else.

confidence.description: Detector confidence for an occupied spot. Null when available.

vehicle_id.description: ByteTrack id of the vehicle in this spot, when known.

held_until.description: Present only when status is held.

cars.description: Vehicles in monitored stalls, in normalized top-down coordinates. Already warped server side; the frontend never does geometry. Only cars occupying a monitored stall appear: the camera sees the whole lot, and publishing every detection scattered dots across the map with no stall under them.

id.description: Stable while the vehicle stays parked. Issued when a stall fills and retired when it empties, rather than by frame to frame motion tracking, which cannot work across frames five minutes apart.

spot_id.description: Which stall this vehicle occupies. Lets the twin draw a car onto its stall without redoing the geometry.

accuracy.description: Running per-spot accuracy against dataset ground truth.

best_spot.description: Nearest available spot to the entrance, excluding held spots.

last_event.description: The most recent state transition, for the activity feed. Null when nothing changed.

vehicle_id.description: The vehicle that arrived or left, so the feed can say "Vehicle 27 left stall 28" rather than just naming the stall.
